sections.About: VIVIM realtime wiki — the reprogrammable product surface. Every section is editable; every edit appends one journal line via POST /api/mutate.
sections.HowTo: Click a section to edit it. Chat (at /chat) sends natural language; this wiki mirrors the resulting state. Both pages poll the same /api/* routes — machine-readable is primary.
sections.Sources: Wiki + chat state: apps/vivim-host/data/demo-baseline/. File surface: data/demo-baseline/file-surface.v1.json. Roadmap: read-through of docs/product/roadmap/roadmap.v1.json — single source of truth, never a copy.

sections.BuildQueue: R002 acceleration active queue is read through from docs/product/roadmap/roadmap.v1.json via GET /api/roadmap. The initial ready frontier is A00, A01 and A02; queued does not imply executed, verified or owner-accepted. This seed section is descriptive only, not a second queue.
sections.Acceleration: Screen 2 projects roadmap, journal and verified source state; edits are receipts through the canonical Host. See docs/product/roadmap/ACCELERATION-R002.md for A00–A08 definitions and dependency rules. This is seeded demo content; live execution is not yet accepted.
